subject.title: [Feature]: expose promptMode parameter in sessions_spawn for deterministic blank sub-agents

question: Should model-callable sessions_spawn expose promptMode, including promptMode="none", or should promptMode remain reserved for trusted lower-level runtime callers?
rationale: The code path is technically clear, but the choice changes the child agent's public API and safety/context envelope, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve constrained promptMode API
options.body: Expose promptMode on sessions_spawn with current defaults preserved, native-runtime semantics explicit, ACP handling defined, and regression tests for none mode.

options.title: Keep promptMode trusted-only
options.body: Leave promptMode off sessions_spawn and document that blank/raw runs must use trusted lower-level APIs or a future maintainer-owned surface.

options.title: Design a semantic blank-worker mode
options.body: Add a higher-level mode instead of exposing the raw prompt enum, trading a larger design step for a narrower public safety contract.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained promptMode API
recommendation.body: Expose promptMode on sessions_spawn with current defaults preserved, native-runtime semantics explicit, ACP handling defined, and regression tests for none mode.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across sessions_spawn, subagent orchestration, docs, and the system-prompt surface.
